# OpenFLUME

> OpenFLUME (Open FLUid Model Environment) is an open-source (MIT), finite-volume thermo-fluid network solver in the class of NASA GFSSP and SINDA/FLUINT. It runs entirely in a web browser: the solver runs in a Web Worker, real-fluid properties come from CoolProp compiled to WebAssembly, and nothing is uploaded. It solves coupled mass, momentum, and energy equations on 1-D pipe-and-node networks with a Newton–Raphson steady solver and a backward-Euler transient solver. It is alpha software (v0.3.1).

Use it for preliminary design and analysis of propulsion feed systems, tank pressurization and blowdown, cryogenic line chilldown, spacecraft thermal/fluid loops, conjugate heat transfer, compressible duct flow (Fanno/Rayleigh, quasi-1-D nozzles), CEA-coupled combustion chambers, and microfluidic networks. It is not CFD. Out of scope: shock capture, method-of-characteristics water hammer, and separated-flow two-phase models (two-phase is homogeneous equilibrium only).

- App (no install): https://openflume.github.io/OpenFLUME/
- Open a built-in example directly: https://openflume.github.io/OpenFLUME/#example=<slug>, e.g. tank-blowdown, cryogenic-line-cooldown, lox-rp-1-thruster-transient-startup, sanity-orifice-hand-calc
- Python: `pip install openflume`
- Source: https://github.com/OpenFLUME/OpenFLUME
- Cite: Rising, J. (2026). OpenFLUME: Open FLUid Model Environment. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22051608

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://openflume.github.io/OpenFLUME/docs/guides/getting-started.html): first simulation in five minutes
- [User's manual](https://openflume.github.io/OpenFLUME/docs/user-manual.html): governing equations, component relations, solution methods, interface, worked examples, verification
- [Examples gallery](https://openflume.github.io/OpenFLUME/docs/examples.html): all built-in models with deep links
- [Python package](https://openflume.github.io/OpenFLUME/docs/python.html): API, CLI, sweeps
- [Coming from GFSSP or SINDA/FLUINT](https://openflume.github.io/OpenFLUME/docs/guides/from-gfssp.html)
- [Sharing models](https://openflume.github.io/OpenFLUME/docs/guides/sharing.html): the model is encoded in the URL fragment and is never uploaded
